title: Harness notice:

items.content: Markdown renderer: draw lists of `Label: value` items tight, part records where the first label repeats, mute plain labels; keep streaming layout identical to at-once layout; tests + docs
Independent review of the renderer + streaming change for regressions and missing tests
Run fmt, clippy (-D warnings) and the aura-ui-terminal tests; check the screenshot case renders as intended

summary: The reviewer did report back, but its message was cut off at 4000 characters, so I only have the first two of its six risks. It found no correctness bugs.
